title: Content library
subtitle: Publish courses for academies to copy and customize.

create.heading: Create a library course
create.body: Create a draft, then publish it when it is ready for academies to copy.
create.description_placeholder: Variables, loops and functions across 12 modules

copies.heading: Academies using {{title}}
copies.body: See which academies copied this course, the version they copied, and whether they have edited it.

empty.heading: No master courses yet
empty.body: Create the first one. Once you publish it, every academy in the organization can take a copy.
empty.search_body: Try a different word, or clear the search to see the whole library.

unavailable.title: Could not load the library
unavailable.body: Refresh the page and try again.

edit.heading: Rename library course
edit.body: Academies that already copied it keep the name they chose.

import.description: Copy the course and its hidden content into a separate library draft. Student work and class assignments are excluded.
import.success: Copied to library as a draft.
import.origin: Copied from {{academy}} · {{course}} · revision {{revision}} on {{date}}. This is an independent copy.

blockers.INVALID_DEFINITION: Review and save the material definition.
blockers.SUBTYPE_MISSING: Restore the missing material in the source course.
blockers.SUBTYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Review the material type and its attached content with the academy editor.
blockers.ASSET_NOT_READY: Finish preparing the attachment, then refresh.
blockers.ASSET_MISSING: Restore or reattach the missing or changed file.
blockers.ASSET_INCOMPATIBLE: Replace the referenced file with a supported image.
blockers.ASSET_UNREFERENCED: Restore the image in this section using its own attachments.
blockers.CAPTION_INVALID: Refresh or reattach the caption and check for duplicate languages.
blockers.PDF_REFERENCE_INVALID: Choose a supplementary PDF from this course.
blockers.TESTS_MISSING: Add tests before assigning this automatically graded exercise.
blockers.PDF_REFERENCE_HIDDEN: Make the referenced PDF and its parent lessons visible before publishing the exercise.

import.repair_source: After the source is repaired by an academy editor, refresh this preview.

fields.material: Review and save the material settings.
fields.quiz: Check the quiz choices, answer key, and grading settings.
fields.choice: Review and save the multiple-choice settings.
fields.choice_options: Give each option valid content and a unique ID.
fields.choice_answer: Select a valid correct option for the selection mode.
fields.choice_explanation: Enter a valid answer explanation or turn the explanation off.
fields.short_answer: Review and save the short-answer settings.
fields.short_answer_key: Enter the expected answer or pattern for the grading mode.
fields.short_answer_explanation: Enter a valid short-answer explanation or turn it off.
fields.turtle_entry: Choose an existing Python file as the Turtle entry point.
fields.files: Check the source files and save them with valid paths.
fields.solution: Review and save a valid reference solution.
fields.project: Check the project’s files, language, and compile settings.
fields.starter_bundle: Review the visible starter files and save the project again.
fields.grading: Check the exercise language and grading settings.
fields.explanation_main: Add valid content to the main explanation.
fields.explanation_side: Repair the side explanation or clear that pane.
fields.public_assets: Remove and reattach the affected instruction files.
fields.solution_assets: Remove and reattach the affected solution files.
fields.pdf: Review or replace the PDF attachment.
fields.pdf_reference: Choose a supplementary PDF from this course.
fields.video: Review the video’s placement and scoring settings.
fields.captions: Review and reattach captions with unique languages.
fields.quiz_choices: Give each quiz option a unique ID and valid text.
fields.quiz_answer: Select one of the existing quiz choices as the correct answer.
fields.quiz_explanation: Review and save the quiz explanation.

media_states.processing: Wait for processing to finish, then refresh.
media_states.failed: Processing failed. Replace the attachment or retry processing.
media_states.deleting: An attachment is being removed. Restore it or attach a replacement.
media_states.unavailable: The attachment is unavailable. Upload a replacement.

picker.description: Choose a course from any academy to copy into the library as an independent draft.

language.label: Course type
language.locked: The language is fixed once the course has problems.

PYTHON.title: Python
PYTHON.description: Python 3. Run and Test in the browser; Submit is graded on the server.

C_CPP.title: C / C++
C_CPP.description: GCC 12. Each problem is C or C++; Run, Test and Submit compile on the server.

WEB.title: Web
WEB.description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Students code in their own editor, so coding practice is not offered.

sync.heading: Library updates
sync.changes: {{changed}} changed · {{added}} added · {{removed}} removed, ready to publish
sync.no_changes: All saved changes have been published.
sync.copies_empty: No academy has adopted this course yet.
sync.batch_help: Save your changes across the course, then publish them together. Academies are notified only when their own edits need review.
sync.batch_published: Updates published. Academy copies will sync automatically.

legacy.title: Existing academy copies
legacy.description: Link old copies to published updates. Uncertain material identities are reviewed by academy editors; their content is preserved.
legacy.review: {{count}} library nodes will require identity review. Linking will not replace academy content.
